Select molecule_dictionary.chembl_id AS chembl_id, molecule_dictionary.pref_name AS pref_name, compound_structures.canonical_smiles AS canonical_smiles, target_dictionary.chembl_id AS indication_curie, target_dictionary.pref_name AS indication_label, molecule_dictionary.max_phase AS max_phase_for_ind From molecule_dictionary Join drug_indication On molecule_dictionary.molregno = drug_indication.molregno Join target_dictionary On drug_indication.tid = target_dictionary.tid Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno Where target_dictionary.target_type = 'DISEASE' And target_dictionary.pref_name = 'Chronic kidney disease' And molecule_dictionary.therapeutic_flag = 1 Order By chembl_id pref_name canonical_smiles indication_curie indication_label max_phase_for_ind
